description: Returns loose diamonds currently listed on vykadiamonds.com (VYKA, Dubai), natural or lab-grown, with the same selection, order and prices as the website's diamond pages. Use this when the user wants to find or compare diamonds VYKA sells, by shape, carat, colour, clarity or budget. Only stones with a laboratory grading report are returned (natural: GIA, IGI or HRD; lab-grown: also GCAL). Unless the user sets a value, the website's own starting filters apply: natural 0.5 ct and up, colour D–H, clarity VS2 or better, Excellent or Ideal cut where the laboratory grades cut, Very Good or Excellent polish and symmetry; lab-grown 1.0 ct and up, colour D–F, clarity VS1 or better, Excellent or Ideal cut where graded, Excellent polish and symmetry; both: eye-clean, no tinge, returnable, with photo and 360° view, lowest price first. Any value the user gives replaces that default. Limits: at most 10 stones per call; stock changes quickly and a listed stone can sell at any time; AED prices are the charged prices, other currencies are indicative. Does not cover ring settings, finished rings, gemstones or fancy-colour diamonds, and cannot reserve or buy a stone.

carat_max.description: Largest carat weight (20 = no upper limit).

clarity_highest.description: Highest clarity grade to include (FL is the highest).

clarity_lowest.description: Lowest clarity grade to include, e.g. VS1 for 'VS1 or better'.

colour_highest.description: Highest colour grade to include (D is the highest).

colour_lowest.description: Lowest colour grade to include, e.g. G for 'G or better'.

currency.description: Currency of max_price and of the indicative price shown beside the AED price.

shape.description: One or more shapes. Leave out for every shape.

type.description: natural = mined diamonds; lab = lab-grown diamonds.

name: search_diamonds

browse_link.description: The matching diamond page on vykadiamonds.com.

cut.description: Cut grade, only where the issuing laboratory grades cut on this shape (IGI: all shapes; GIA: round only).

has_360.description: True when the stone's page shows a 360° view.

id.description: VYKA's stone code, as shown on the website (VYK-<lab letter>-<report number>).

indicative_price.description: The AED price shown in another currency, rounded up to the next 10 as the website does. Indicative only: checkout is in AED.

lab.description: Grading laboratory; null when the stone has no laboratory report.

link.description: The stone on vykadiamonds.com, where it can be viewed and bought.

marks.description: The website's notes on the stone, e.g. Eye-clean, No tinge, Non-returnable.

photo_url.description: This stone's own photo, and the only image to show for it. Images from a web search show other stones. A 360° capture can catch a round stone at a slight angle; the shape field and the measurements are the authority.

price_aed.description: The price in AED exactly as vykadiamonds.com shows it; this is the amount charged.

report_check_url.description: The laboratory's own report-check page for this report.

video_360_url.description: A direct 360° video file when the stone has one; otherwise the 360° view is on the stone's page.

scale.description: Which scale: natural and lab-grown scores do not compare.

title: Search VYKA diamonds
